Elegant Themes “Beautiful Flat Icons”

A free set of 192 flat icons from 2013: objects built from solid shapes on colored circles, with short solid shadows.

Source
Elegant Themes blog (archived copy)
Creator
Elegant Themes
Made
2013
Style
Flat design (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Friendly, clean, playful
Evidence
Downloaded eight icons from Category:Elegant Themes Circle Icons as 330 px renders of the SVG files (calendar, camera, chat, lightbulb, mail, music, rocket, tools), inspected them, and stored them as one contact sheet (1420 × 720) made for this record. Publication date and license read on the Elegant Themes post on 2026-09-28.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Open license, stored. License: GPL-2.0. Rights policy

Context

The post by Nick Roach, published 16 October 2013, offers “a 192 piece set of flat icons” in “full color and single color” versions, “completely free and Open Source under the GPL”.

Wikimedia Commons holds the SVG files under GPL-2.0 with the source and date above (example).

Observed

  • Each icon is a solid circle in muted blue, orange, red, teal, or dark slate.
  • The objects (a calendar, a camera, a speech bubble, a light bulb, an envelope, a music note, a rocket, crossed tools) are built from solid shapes in white, cream, slate, red, and yellow.
  • Every object casts a short shadow down and to the right in a darker tint of the circle color. The shadow has a hard edge and no blur.
  • There are no gradients, highlights, or outlines. Corners of the shapes are slightly rounded.

Why it belongs

Measured with tools/image-traits.py; see the measurement file. The palette is softer than the Flat UI kit, which shows that flat design did not require fully saturated color.

The short solid shadows are the milder form of the 2013 long-shadow trend that NN/g criticises (NN/g 2015).

Borrow

Draw icons as one object on one solid circle, with a single hard shadow in a darker tint of the circle color when you need a hint of depth.
